plugins.name: command-pane
plugins.description: One-click buttons above the prompt, in folders the user customizes, with custom prompt buttons: a build-a-skill prompt, a handover to a new session (needs the howtoai plugin) whose button turns yellow and red as the context fills, a settings pane for technical level, approval detail, and recommended setup, a Today pane of tasks and email per workspace, and a button that opens the skill-design design studio

plugins.name: howtoai
plugins.description: HowToAI skills: skill-builder, skill-finder, skill-audit, skill-design, brain-dump, grilling, and handover

plugins.name: howtoai-dev
plugins.description: HowToAI software-development process (plan, tests first, build, test, review, deploy, learn); 0.10.0 adds INSTALL.md (dev mode or plugin mode, per-user and per-project choices including an Azure DevOps tracker and the plan format) and holds dev-plan (the entry point), dev-test (tests first, safe test runs, TESTING.md), dev-build (smallest traced change behind a lint, format, type-check, and test gate), dev-review (goldfish code review and human review), dev-learn (root cause per finding, lessons log, approved fixes routed lowest level first), dev-deploy (deploys to any named target with its own tools, set up on first use, one approval per production step), with the dev-test-first and dev-safe-target hooks, dev-core, dev-workbook with C#, .NET, Docker, and Terraform workbooks, the plan-review and code-review goldfish (searching wide, with a compliance goldfish for the workbooks and instruction files), scorer, and verifier agents

plugins.name: input-router
plugins.description: Ben AI token-saving mod: Big files and connector results are read by Haiku first; Claude gets short notes and a path to the full thing. A side pane shows each hand-off to Haiku live. /input-router full lets the next one through whole

plugins.name: effort-optimizer
plugins.description: Ben AI token-saving mod: Reads each prompt, picks the effort level it needs, and sets it by itself without asking (HowToAI change; based on Ben's four-question framework)

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Ben AI token-saving mod: BenAI copy of claude-code-templates' Jev Model Router (MIT), changed to use Haiku in place of Jev. Haiku reads each subagent task at agent.spawn and answers in JSON with a tier and a confidence from 0 to 1; a task moves to a cheaper model only when that confidence is at least minDowngradeConfidence. Logs every pick, the model it replaced and the estimated cost difference to ~/.claude/mods-logs/savings.jsonl. No API key and no network call of its own. Never changes the main chat's model; main-chat effort routing is off by default.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Ben AI token-saving mod: Counts down until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, above the prompt. When a big chat goes cold, offers a handoff to a fresh chat. Keep warm pings the cache in the background so it does not go cold (kept for reference; not installed, to be merged into the command-pane Handover)

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Ben AI token-saving mod: At 250k tokens, offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat, shows the steps with progress bars, then copies it or starts a new chat with it. Logs every run to ~/.claude/handoffs/handoff.log and saves a draft first (kept for reference; not installed, to be merged into the command-pane Handover)

plugins.name: research-router
plugins.description: Ben AI token-saving mod: Keeps web research out of the main chat: Haiku shortens Claude's own big search results, and /research-router has a cheap worker or subagents read real pages and give Claude a short brief with sources

plugins.name: efficient-browser-use
plugins.description: Ben AI token-saving mod: Cheaper browser tasks: shrinks every screenshot Claude takes while it drives a browser, or has Haiku describe it in words. /efficient-browser full lets one full-size screenshot through

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: Ben AI token-saving mod: A Mods pane that finds every mod on this computer by itself, turns each one on or off in every chat, and opens the side-pane ones

plugins.name: savings-proof
plugins.description: Ben AI token-saving mod: /savings opens the Savings Proof pane: every token the other mods saved, with today's and this chat's totals
